acceptance: Root cause confirmed with a local reproduction
A refused official run always prints its reason, including under --quiet, with a test
The nightly throughput configs run a phase set the official gate accepts, or use the non-official run path if a partial run is intended, without weakening the gate
t3:throughput duckdb and cedardb green in the next nightly
context:
2026-11-12: PR #4220 merged (9e1f9208d7 2026-11-14T03:13:05Z). Root cause: uat-throughput-{duckdb,cedardb}-nightly.yaml ran official TPC-H with phases load,throughput; #4137's gate requires power and throughput, and the refusal went to the silenced console under --quiet (run_official also relabelled the exit as 'Benchmark execution failed: 1'). Fix: refusals print via fatal() to stderr under --quiet with a test; configs use load,power,throughput; gate unchanged. Second bug found and fixed: a TPC-H Q16 row count inside the loose non-reference-seed tolerance was recorded as an exact PASSED and failed export; now SKIPPED with a warning (result_capture and DataFrame validation, tests for both). Local: duckdb cell exit 0 at SF1, 132 queries passed, refresh included, validate_throughput_result ok for 3 streams. Remaining: close when the next nightly shows t3:throughput duckdb and cedardb green (CedarDB not run locally).

2026-11-15: nightlies 43604460150 (3f8cf88f4a) and 43726725879 (f5a9646d7e), both after #4220, still fail t3:throughput, now for new reasons. DuckDB: the cell passes (exit 0) but the validator reports 37 errors, first 'summary.validation=passed contradicts queries[3].row_count_validation.status=SKIPPED' — #4220's change recording loose-tolerance row counts as SKIPPED is inconsistent with the run-level validation summary, so validator_clean_rate is 0% against a 1.0 floor. CedarDB: the result JSON is written but the cell exits 1, and the throughput assertion reports 'stream count mismatch: requested 3, executed 1'.

PR #4260 (7ceda027f7, merged 2026-11-16T04:17Z) fixes both post-#4220 failures. DuckDB: the validator rejected any non-PASSED row beside summary.validation=passed (all 37 errors); now a SKIPPED row may sit beside a passed summary only with a documented reason (data refreshed / within tolerance / within range), undocumented skips still contradict, and all-SKIPPED runs summarise as NOT_VALIDATED. Local SF1 nightly cell exit 0, validator rollup 100% clean. CedarDB: supports_refresh_functions was False, so run-official's mandatory RF1/RF2 failed power and throughput (hence 'executed 1'); enabling it exposed RF1's explicit BEGIN inside psycopg's implicit transaction, which CedarDB rejects; _begin_transaction now skips BEGIN when autocommit is False; CedarDB TPC-DS maintenance stays off. Local mocker SF0.01: 3 streams executed, 132/132 queries passed. Close when the next nightly shows both t3:throughput jobs green.
description: Nightly-v2 runs 43254687916 (2026-11-12) and 43453477982 (2026-11-13): t3:throughput duckdb and cedardb cells run `benchbox run-official tpch --scale 1.0 --phases load,throughput --streams 3 --seed 20260709 --quiet` and exit 1 after the banner with no error text (terminal_state no_json_nonzero, 'recorded no result_path'). Last green before PR #4137 (f4ffb30eaf, 2026-11-12), which made --official refuse partial phases and TPC-H runs without refresh functions. Likely two defects: the nightly throughput configs request a phase set the official gate now refuses, and the refusal is not printed under --quiet.
